title: Hydroquinone 5-O-Cinnamoyl Ester of Renieramycin M Suppresses Lung Cancer Stem Cells by Targeting Akt and Destabilizes c-Myc.
authors: Hongwiangchan, Nattamon; Sriratanasak, Nicharat; Wichadakul, Duangdao; Aksorn, Nithikoon; Chamni, Supakarn; Chanvorachote, Pithi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物CIN-RM通过抑制Akt/mTOR信号通路降解c-Myc来抑制肺癌干细胞，仅含分子对接分析化合物与Akt蛋白结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are distinct cancer populations with tumorigenic and self-renewal abilities. CSCs are drivers of cancer initiation, progression, therapeutic failure, and disease recurrence. Thereby, novel compounds targeting CSCs offer a promising way to control cancer. In this study, the hydroquinone 5-O-cinnamoyl ester of renieramycin M (CIN-RM) was demonstrated to suppress lung cancer CSCs. CIN-RM was toxic to lung cancer cells with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration of around 15 microM. CIN-RM suppressed CSCs by inhibiting colony and tumor spheroid formation. In addition, the CSC population was isolated and treated and the CSCs were dispatched in response to CIN-RM within 24 h. CIN-RM was shown to abolish cellular c-Myc, a central survival and stem cell regulatory protein, with the depletion of CSC markers and stem cell transcription factors ALDH1A1, Oct4, Nanog, and Sox2. For up-stream regulation, we found that CIN-RM significantly inhibited Akt and consequently decreased the pluripotent transcription factors. CIN-RM also inhibited mTOR, while slightly decreasing p-GSK3beta (Ser9) but rarely affected the protein kinase C (PKC) signal. Inhibiting Akt/mTOR induced ubiquitination of c-Myc and promoted degradation. The mechanism of how Akt regulates the stability of c-Myc was validated with the Akt inhibitor wortmannin. The computational analysis further confirmed the strong interaction between CIN-RM and the Akt protein with a binding affinity of -10.9 kcal/mol at its critical active site. Taken together, we utilized molecular experiments, the CSC phenotype, and molecular docking methods to reveal the novel suppressing the activity of this compound on CSCs to benefit CSC-targeted therapy for lung cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 癌症干细胞（CSCs）是具有致瘤和自我更新能力的独特癌细胞群体。CSCs是癌症发生、进展、治疗失败和疾病复发的驱动因素。因此，靶向CSCs的新型化合物为控制癌症提供了一种有前景的方法。在本研究中，氢醌5-O-肉桂酰酯衍生物雷尼霉素M（CIN-RM）被证明能抑制肺癌CSCs。CIN-RM对肺癌细胞具有毒性，其半数抑制浓度约为15微摩尔。CIN-RM通过抑制集落和肿瘤球形成来抑制CSCs。此外，分离并处理了CSC群体，CSCs在24小时内对CIN-RM产生响应而被清除。CIN-RM被证明能消除细胞c-Myc（一种关键的生存和干细胞调控蛋白），同时耗尽CSC标志物和干细胞转录因子ALDH1A1、Oct4、Nanog和Sox2。在上游调控方面，我们发现CIN-RM显著抑制Akt，并因此降低多能性转录因子。CIN-RM还抑制mTOR，同时略微降低p-GSK3β（Ser9），但几乎不影响蛋白激酶C（PKC）信号。抑制Akt/mTOR诱导c-Myc的泛素化并促进其降解。Akt调控c-Myc稳定性的机制通过Akt抑制剂渥曼青霉素得到验证。计算分析进一步证实了CIN-RM与Akt蛋白在其关键活性位点的强相互作用，结合亲和力为-10.9 kcal/mol。综上所述，我们利用分子实验、CSC表型和分子对接方法揭示了该化合物对CSCs的新型抑制活性，以利于肺癌治疗中的CSC靶向疗法。
